newsitem.title: USA: Unocal, PDVSA close refinery, petrochems deal.
newsitem.headline: Unocal, PDVSA close refinery, petrochems deal.

text.p: Unocal Corp said that it and and PDV America, Inc., a unit of Petroleos de Venezuela, S.A. (PDVSA) have closed a deal on restructuring of UNO-VEN Co, a Midwest refining and marketing partnership held 50-50 by affiliates of Unocal and PDV America.
Unocal said in a statement on Friday that PDV America will receive most of the refining and marketing assets of UNO-VEN, while Unocal will receive the partnership venture and $250 million in cash.

The move is part of Unocal's strategy to exit the U.S. downstream sector and the PDV units will acquire a 153,000 barrels per day refinery near Chicago, a lubricants plant in Ohio and storage terminals.
